!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-synthetic-vrf-new !!!!!
configure terminal
! aaa: the method lists tacctl renders, each replaced by the rendered line
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
! snmp: the SNMP block of scope 'lab' (its communities, access lists, trap hosts and 'enable traps' lines)
snmp-server host 192.0.2.61 vrf MGMT version 2c poller-traps
snmp-server host 192.0.2.62 informs version 2c poller-traps
snmp-server host 192.0.2.63 version 2c poller-traps udp-port 1162 config
! system: the statements of the system block of scope 'lab'
ip domain name lab.example.net
ip domain name vrf MGMT mgmt.example.net
ip domain list lab.example.net
ip domain list vrf MGMT mgmt.example.net
ip name-server 192.0.2.53
ip name-server vrf MGMT 192.0.2.53
ip name-server vrf MGMT 192.0.2.54
ntp server 192.0.2.123 prefer
ntp server vrf MGMT 192.0.2.123 version 3 prefer
ntp server vrf OOB ntp2.example.net
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
line con 0
 login authentication CONSOLE
end
